mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation with positive returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE below 5.0% for two consecutive months, S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases or average return not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in nonfarm payrolls signals accommodative monetary policy combined with strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through valuation and earnings support.
failure_condition: Interaction term between FEDFUNDS and PAYEMS does not significantly predict 60-day returns (p>0.05) or Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong consumer demand regimes, rising residential sales (RSAFS) indicates elevated consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS rising 3 consecutive months), S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases or average return not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or correlation with positive returns not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate rises above 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 3.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In periods with FEDFUNDS above 3.5% for two consecutive months, S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of cases or average return not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in residential sales signals strong labor market supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings and sentiment effects.
failure_condition: Interaction term between UNRATE and RSAFS does not significantly predict 60-day returns (p>0.05) or Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 thousand units indicates increased construction activity and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 2000 thousand units), S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases or average return not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).
